project_type: AWS AgentCore demo monorepo: Python Strands agent + thin FastAPI forwarder (api/) + mock/real tool Lambdas (tools-lambdas/) + Python CDK (infra-cdk/) + a Next.js 16 / React 19 / TypeScript / Tailwind 4 chat frontend being ported into frontend/. Gitea bootstrap assets go in gitea/.
language: Python 3.13 (agent, api, tools-lambdas, infra-cdk) and TypeScript/React (frontend).
build_system: Python: per-component venvs + pip. Frontend: npm (package-lock.json present; NOT yarn/pnpm), Node 24 / npm 11. CDK: aws-cdk-lib >=2.251,<3 (Python), run from infra-cdk/ which has its OWN .venv.
test_framework: Python: pytest (per component). Frontend: vitest (run one-shot via `npm run test` == `vitest run`). CDK: pytest assertions in infra-cdk/tests using aws_cdk.assertions.Template.
build_command: Frontend: `cd frontend; npm ci; npm run build` (next build; after adding output:'export' this emits out/). CDK: `cdk synth --all` from infra-cdk/ with the infra-cdk .venv active. Python Lambdas/api/agent have no compile step beyond import.
test_command: Frontend: `cd frontend; npm run lint; npm run test` (vitest run). CDK: from infra-cdk/ `cdk synth --all` (must exit 0 offline, Docker-free, no creds) AND `pytest tests -q`. tools-lambdas: `pytest tools-lambdas/tests -q` (needs moto installed in the venv). Agent: `pytest agent -q` run in a shell with NO MAHALO_* env vars. api: `pytest api -q`.

Real mode must short-circuit the Store/seed (design Â§C.4). Frontend: api.ts has a request()/normalizeErrorMessage wrapper and api.get/post/... helpers that JSON.stringify the body; keep that plumbing, swap the auth header + base-url default.
